description: Activate when: user says 'I used to love this but don't anymore', 'I feel like I've stopped learning', 'I go through the motions but nothing excites me', 'how do I stay curious as I get older', or a domain expert's knowledge has visibly stagnated despite continued effort. Do NOT activate when: the problem is burnout rather than curiosity deficit (burnout requires recovery first); the issue is capability or skill gap rather than curiosity; structural causes (bad environment, financial stress) are driving the motivation problem. More: deciqai.com/c/curiosity-learning-curve
